Circle area represents the current or projected balance. Dotted circles show target amounts on the same scale. Pinch to zoom and drag to explore. Keyboard users can press + or − to zoom, and Home to fit. Labels appear when there is room and stay the same size. Purpose colours identify your Pots: blue for cash, violet for investing and learning, and warm tones for family, experiences and time together. Reached labels mark completed targets or repaid loans. Investment values are illustrative; the range alongside net worth shows alternative outcomes.

The centre investment estimate uses your current illustrative growth assumption. The surrounding range is a set of scenarios, not a confidence interval. Outcomes can fall outside it, including losses.

These are nominal values. Inflation, tax, fees, product interest and changes to earnings or spending are not modelled. Agreed current-account allocations assume future income can fund them. Paused funding, and money released when a Rule stops at its target or a loan is repaid, stays in cash unless redirected. Rules from other Pots transfer existing balances. Conditional Rules assume their condition is met; round-ups use the stated monthly estimate and cap. A reached savings target remains saved until you choose to spend it.

Soft grey bubbles and timeline markers are suggested possibilities, not balances or commitments. Their size has no monetary meaning and they stay outside projections until you make them real. Personal colours and photos identify Pots; Reached labels indicate completed targets. Life-stage prompts are illustrative, not peer data. AI ideas and conversations are simulated locally for this prototype. There is no real bank connection.

Circle area represents the current or projected balance. Dotted circles show target amounts on the same scale. Pinch to zoom and drag to explore. Keyboard users can press + or − to zoom, and Home to fit. Labels appear when there is room and stay the same size. Purpose colours identify your Pots: blue for cash, violet for investing and learning, and warm tones for family, experiences and time together. Reached labels mark completed targets or repaid loans. Investment values are illustrative; the range alongside net worth shows alternative outcomes.

The centre investment estimate uses your current illustrative growth assumption. The surrounding range is a set of scenarios, not a confidence interval. Outcomes can fall outside it, including losses.

These are nominal values. Inflation, tax, fees, product interest and changes to earnings or spending are not modelled. Agreed current-account allocations assume future income can fund them. Paused funding, and money released when a Rule stops at its target or a loan is repaid, stays in cash unless redirected. Rules from other Pots transfer existing balances. Conditional Rules assume their condition is met; round-ups use the stated monthly estimate and cap. A reached savings target remains saved until you choose to spend it.

Soft grey bubbles and timeline markers are suggested possibilities, not balances or commitments. Their size has no monetary meaning and they stay outside projections until you make them real. Personal colours and photos identify Pots; Reached labels indicate completed targets. Life-stage prompts are illustrative, not peer data. AI ideas and conversations are simulated locally for this prototype. There is no real bank connection.
